question.question_text: Which item was used more frequently by the camera wearer during the baking activity: the metal plate or the plastic cup?

answer_options.text: The plastic cup was used more frequently
The video does not show the use of a metal plate, only a plastic cup
The metal plate was used more frequently
Both were used with the same frequency
Neither item was visibly used; the ingredients were added directly by hand

A metal bowl is also present in the scene, but there is no direct visual evidence of it being used during the baking activity. The video does not provide direct visual evidence of the metal plate or the plastic cup being used during the baking activity.
